- `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/profile-boot-*.js` — guards the C"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ordis server-side HMR loop, which depends on a Node-internal ESM loader hook that Bun does not provi"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"is server-side HMR loop, which depends on a Node-internal ESM loader hook that Bun does not provide."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Both edits are reverted on exit, so the user's `node_modules` is left untouched when the process ter"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"everted on exit, so the user's `node_modules` is left untouched when the process terminates cleanly."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Problem it solves"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"DSH relies on a handful of Node APIs. T"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"he compat layer re-implements it on top of `Bun.Transpiler({ loader: "ts" }).transformSync`, which i"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"s semantically equivalent and synchronous, matching the contract DSH expects when passing TypeScript"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" source through `workerData`."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Everything else DSH uses is already covered by Bun:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **`node:worker_threads`** — fully supported (`Worker`, `workerData`, `parentPort`, `resourceLimits"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"`, `stdout` / `stderr`, `eventLoopUtilization`).

When upgrading Bun o"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"r DSH, re-verify that the patch logic still applies."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Install alongside DSH in the same project:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"`bun run build` produces `./lib/{preload,node-module}.js` (plus `.map` source maps)."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Launch DSH through Bun with the compat preload:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The preload detects the DSH entry, applies the in-place patches, spawns the DSH process as a child B"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"un runtime, forwards `SIGINT` / `SIGTERM`, and restores the original files before exit."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Environment variables"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Variable | Set by | Purpose |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| `DSH_BUN_COMPAT_CHILD` | preload | Marks the spawned child so the preload becomes a no-op there. P"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"revents recursive patching. |
| `DSH_BUN_COMPAT_DISABLE_HMR` | preload | Tells the patched `profile-"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"boot-*.js` files to skip the Cordis HMR loop. |
| `DSH_BUN_COMPAT_LIB` | preload (optional) | Overri"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"de for the directory holding `lib/node-module.js`. The preload normally walks up from `import.meta.d"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"ir` to locate it. |
| `DSH_BUN_COMPAT_DEBUG` | user | When set, prints an indented tree of any uncau"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"ght error (including `cause` and aggregated `errors[]`) to stderr. |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## How the in-place patch works"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"1. `prepareInPlacePatch` reads `dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread/lib/index.js`, backs the bytes up to "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"`$TMPDIR/dsh-bun-compat-patch-backup-*/index.js.bak`, and rewrites the `from "node:module"` import t"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"o `from "<compatLib>/node-module.js"` via a `file://` URL. A marker comment is prepended so a second"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" run can detect the file is already patched and skip re-patching.
2. `patchHmrGuards` iterates every"},{"id":"p30s5","text":" `dsh/lib/profile-boot-*.js` and prefixes the existing `if (!signalShutdown.signal.aborted && ctx.fi"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"ber.state === 2 && ctx.get("loader") !== void 0) try {` guard with `!process.env.DSH_BUN_COMPAT_DISA"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"BLE_HMR &&` so the HMR loop short-circuits under Bun.
3. On clean exit, signal, or `process.exit`, `"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"restorePatch` walks every backup and writes the original bytes back, then deletes the backup directo"},{"id":"p30s9","text":"torePatch` walks every backup and writes the original bytes back, then deletes the backup directory."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"If the parent dies before cleanup (`kill -9`, power loss) a follow-up run will see the marker on the"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" DSH file but no corresponding backup; it logs and skips, leaving the file patched. The user must re"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"install DSH (or restore the file manually) in that case. Treat any `kill -9` of the parent as leavin"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"g DSH in a dirty state."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Project layout"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"The build emits only two files into `./lib`:"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- `preload.js` — bundled with `shadow.ts` and `diagnostic.ts` inlined.
